meta_data.base_class: Analyze the <specific aspect of the website> of the given website - referring to a specific dimension that can be evaluated or measured for the website.

tool_template.name: Website<class>Analyzer
tool_template.description: Analyze the <class> of a given website.

website_url.description: The URL of the website to be analyzed. It must be a valid URL format.

scan_depth.description: The depth of the <class> scan, ranging from 1 to 5.

analysis_frequency.description: How often the <class> analysis should be performed, could be 'daily', 'weekly' or 'monthly'.

report_format.description: The format in which the <class> analysis report should be generated. One of: 'PDF', 'HTML', 'JSON'.

notification_email.description: Email address where notifications about the <class> analysis results should be sent. Must be a valid email format.

analysis_timeout.description: Maximum allowed time in seconds for the <class> analysis to complete before timing out, ranging from 30 to 3600 seconds.

priority_level.description: Priority level of the <class> analysis, where 1 is the highest priority and 5 the lowest.
